about.heading: About {app}
about.libraries_hint: Linked into the app; each keeps its own license.
backup.checksum_required: none beside it; restore needs it
backup.create_hint: Read the whole NAND twice, check that both reads match, and save the image with its SHA-256
backup.delete_description: {name} and its .sha256 are removed from the folder. This cannot be undone.
backup.delete_hint: Delete this backup and its checksum after confirmation
backup.description: Each backup is the whole NAND, read twice and checked, with its SHA-256 beside it. A restore writes a verified image back.
backup.empty_hint: Back up unit reads the whole NAND into this folder. Do it before the first patch.
backup.restore_disabled_checksum: A SHA-256 file is required beside this backup before it can be restored
backup.restore_file_hint: Choose a NAND image to verify and restore; its SHA-256 file must be beside it
backup.restore_hint: Verify this backup and overwrite the connected thermostat's NAND after confirmation
backup.title: NAND backups
boot.description: Boots the application firmware from whatever mode the unit is in, through recovery U-Boot and the stock U-Boot from NAND.
command.connected_device: The unit on USB is a {device}.
command.disabled: Connect one 3rd generation thermostat, finish any operation, close file pickers, and disconnect any open console first
console.description: A terminal on the root shell of a patched unit, over its USB serial port. While it is open no run can start.
download.connect: Connect the USB port on the back of the display to this computer with a data cable.
download.hold_button: Hold the front panel button for 10 seconds to enter USB download mode.
download.title: Put the device in USB download mode
logs.delete_description: Runs older than 30 days are removed from the logs folder. The others stay.
logs.delete_old_hint: Remove run folders older than 30 days after confirmation; keep recent logs and the active run
logs.description: Every run that touches the unit keeps a log of its steps and every exchange — what an issue needs.
logs.filter_hint: Show only log lines containing this text, ignoring case
logs.reveal_hint: Open the folder containing this run's log files
nand.volume_order_hint: UBI volumes in order; hover for chip offset
nav.about_page_hint: View the app version, licenses, and credits
nav.backups_hint: Save, inspect, restore, and delete whole-NAND backups
nav.boot_hint: Boot the connected thermostat's application firmware
nav.logs_hint: Inspect the steps and logs of current and past runs
nav.patch_hint: Choose patch options and apply them to the thermostat
nav.terminal_hint: Open a USB serial root shell on a patched thermostat
nav.uboot_hint: Load recovery U-Boot and open its USB console
patch.about: Patches the root volume the unit boots, then boots it. Nothing else on the NAND is written.
patch.backplate_sim_hint: nlclient drives a simulated backplate with a simulated temperature
patch.backup_volume_hint: About 45 s, into the runs folder
patch.block_cloud_hint: Block the thermostat's access to Nest and Google servers; use a custom NTP server for time
patch.boot_slot_hint: Choose the root slot to patch; auto follows the thermostat's boot order
patch.cloud_hint: Replace nlclient's cloud endpoint with your own server; unavailable when nestlocal is installed
patch.device_hint: Override the detected thermostat generation; leave on auto for USB detection
patch.external_temperature_hint: Regulates from temperatures sent over MQTT, Zigbee or Matter using one sensor named after the thermostat's room, with fallback to its own sensor. 2nd generation: needs the reviewed 5.9.4-5 nlclient patch. 3rd generation: turns off Bluetooth, so real Nest Temperature Sensors stop working.
patch.doom_hint: Launched from the UNFR0ZEN screen; hold the button 3 s to quit
patch.dry_run_hint: List the changes, write nothing, boot the unit unchanged
patch.entry_point_choice_hint: Choose how to enter the 3rd generation's boot ROM; auto tries all entry points
patch.entry_point_disabled_hint: Entry point selection is only available for a 3rd generation thermostat
patch.entry_point_hint: How the 3rd generation's boot ROM is entered: auto tries all
patch.file.choose_hint: Choose a {kind} file from your computer
patch.file.clear_hint: Remove this file from the patch options; the file itself is kept
patch.matter.pairing_code_hint: The pairing code to enter in your Matter controller when adding the thermostat
patch.matter.thread_disabled_hint: Turn off Zigbee first: Thread and Zigbee cannot share the radio
patch.matter.thread_hint: Use the onboard radio for Matter over Thread; replaces Heat Link and cannot be combined with Zigbee
patch.matter_hint: Install nestlocal to pair the thermostat with a Matter controller; Thread is optional
patch.mqtt.broker_hint: MQTT broker hostname or IP address, optionally followed by :port
patch.mqtt.tls_hint: Encrypt the MQTT connection with TLS; choose a CA certificate if your broker needs a private CA
patch.mqtt_hint: Install nestlocal to publish thermostat state and receive commands through your MQTT broker
patch.nestlocal_owns_overlay_cloud: MQTT, Matter, Zigbee and Doom install nestlocal, which has its own
patch.ntp_hint: Use your chosen NTP server to keep the thermostat's clock in sync
patch.root_password_hint: Set the root login password; leave blank to use unfr0zen
patch.ssh_hint: Enable root access over the network using SSH; set a root password or choose a public key in Advanced
patch.start_disabled: Finish the current operation, close any file picker, and disconnect any open console before starting a run
patch.start_hint: Patch the connected thermostat with the selected options
patch.usb_shell_hint: Enable a root shell over USB serial for the app's Serial console
patch.wwn_boiler_hint: With Zigbee or Thread on a Heat Link model (Display-3.x, Display-5.x): heat through W1 as a Works With Nest boiler. Without it, firmware 6.4-8 can stop on error H71/H74 with no Heat Link
patch.zigbee_disabled_hint: Turn off Thread support first: Zigbee and Thread cannot share the radio
patch.zigbee_hint: Use the onboard radio to join a Zigbee network; replaces Heat Link and cannot be combined with Thread
run.disabled_busy: Finish the current operation, close any file picker, and disconnect any open console first
terminal.clear_hint: Clear the displayed terminal output without disconnecting or sending a command
terminal.connect_disabled_hint: Select an available port and finish any other operation or console connection first
terminal.connect_hint: Open the selected USB serial port; what you type in the terminal goes to the thermostat
terminal.disconnect_hint: Close the serial connection so another operation can use USB
terminal.empty: Connect to a port. What you type goes to the unit.
terminal.port_hint: Choose the thermostat's USB serial port
uboot.description: Loads recovery U-Boot over USB and leaves it at its prompt, which keeps the watchdog serviced. Its console opens below once it is up.
update.restart_description: Restart unfr0zen to use the new version.
